paragraphs.text: And on the new moon of the third month he went forth from the ark, and built an altar And he made atonement for the earth, and took a kid and made atonement by its blood for all the guilt of the earth; for everything that had been on it had been those that were in the ark with Noah.
paragraphs.original: ወበቀዳማዊ፡ ለሣልስ፡ ወርኅ፡ ወፅአ፡ እምነ፡ ታቦት፡ ወሐነጸ፡ ምሥዋዐ፡ በውእቱ፡ ደብር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ba-qadāmāwi la-śāləs warḫ waḍʾa ʾəm-nə tābot wa-ḥanaḍa məśwāʿa ba-wəʾtu dabr

paragraphs.text: And he placed the fat thereof on the altar, and he took an ox, and a goat, and a sheep and kids, and salt, and a turtle-dove, and the young of a dove, and placed a burnt sacrifice on the altar, and poured thereon an offering mingled with oil, and sprinkled wine and strewed frankincense over everything, and caused a goodly savour to arise, acceptable before And the Lord smelt the goodly savour, and He made a covenant with him that there should not be any more a flood to destroy the earth; that all the days of the earth seed-time and harvest should never cease; cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night should change their order, nor cease for ever.
paragraphs.original: ወአስተሳተየ፡ ምድረ፡ ወነሥአ፡ ምራረ፡ ላሕም፡ አሐደ፡ ወበግዐ፡ አሐደ፡ ወአባግዐ፡ ወሐራጊተ፡ አጋዕዝ፡ ወቅርፈ፡ ናርደ፡ ወቅሌ፡ ወቅርፈ፡ ምክርመም፡ ወሰናኤ፡ ወከስቦን፡ ወሥንዶል፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾastasātaya mədra wa-naśʾa mərāra lāḥm ʾaḥada wa-bagʿa ʾaḥada wa-ʾabāgʿa wa-ḥarāgita ʾagāʿz wa-qərfa nārəda wa-qəlē wa-qərfa məkrəmam wa-sanāʾē wa-kasbon wa-śəndol

paragraphs.text: 'And you, increase ye and multiply upon the earth, and become many upon it, and be a blessing upon it. The fear of you and the dread of you I inspire in everything that is on earth and in the sea. And behold I have given unto you all beasts, and all winged things, and everything that moves on the earth, and the fish in the things for food; as the green herbs, I have given you all things to eat.
paragraphs.original: ወወደየ፡ ኵሎ፡ ላዕለ፡ እሳት፡ ዘውስተ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምሥዋዕ፡ ወአዕረገ፡ ላዕለ፡ መሥዋዕተ፡ ሠናየ፡ ለመዓዛ፡ ዘይትፈቀር፡ ቅድመ፡ እግዚእ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-wadaya kwəlo lāʿla ʾəsāt zawəsta lāʿla məśwāʿ wa-ʾaʿraga lāʿla maśwāʿta śannāya la-maʿāzā zayətfaqqar qədma ʾəgziʾ

paragraphs.text: But flesh, with the life thereof, with the blood, ye shall not eat; for the life of all flesh is in the blood, lest your blood of your lives be required. At the hand of every man, at the hand of every (beast) will I require Whoso sheddeth man's blood by man shall his blood be shed, for in the God made He man.
paragraphs.original: ወአጠምቀ፡ እግዚእ፡ ለመዓዛ፡ ሠናይ፡ ወአቀመ፡ ቦቱ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ምስለ፡ ኖኅ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይኩን፡ ካልአ፡ ማየ፡ አይኅ፡ ለማስኖ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾaṭamqa ʾəgziʾ la-maʿāzā śannāy wa-ʾaqama bottu kidāna məsla Noḫ kama ʾi-yəkun kāləʾa māya ʾāyəḫ la-māsno mədr

paragraphs.text: And you, increase ye, and multiply on the earth.' his sons swore that they would not eat any blood that was in any flesh, and he made a covenant Lord God for ever throughout all the generations of the earth in this month.
paragraphs.original: ወይቤ፡ ይብዝኁ፡ ወይብዙኁ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ወይኅነጽዋ፡ ወይኩኑ፡ ለፍርሀተ፡ ወለድንጋፄ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሉ፡ ዘውስቴታ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-yəbē yəbzəḫu wa-yəbzəḫu lāʿla mədr wa-yəḫənaḍəwā wa-yəkunu la-fərhata wa-la-dəngāḍē lāʿla kwəlu zawəstatēhā

paragraphs.text: account He spake to thee that thou shouldst make a covenant with the children of Israel in this month upon the mountain with an oath, and that thou shouldst sprinkle blood upon them because of all the words of the covenant, which the Lord made with them for ever.
paragraphs.original: ወኵሉ፡ ዘይትሐወስ፡ ወዘሕያው፡ ውእቱ፡ ይኩንክሙ፡ ለሲሳይ፡ ከመ፡ ኀመልማለ፡ ሣዕር፡ ወሀብኩክሙ፡ ኵሎ፡ ለበሊዕ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-kwəlu zayətḥawwas wa-zaḥəyāw wəʾtu yəkunəkəmu la-sisāy kama ḫamalmāla śāʿrə wahabkukəmu kwəlo la-balʿiʿ

paragraphs.text: And this testimony is written concerning you that you should observe it continually, so that you should not eat on any day any blood of beasts or birds or cattle during all the days of the earth, and the man who eats the blood of beast or of cattle or of birds during all the days of the earth, he and his seed shall be rooted out of the land.
paragraphs.original: ወባሕቱ፡ ሥጋ፡ ምስለ፡ ነፍሱ፡ ምስለ፡ ደሙ፡ ኢትብልዑ፡ እስመ፡ ነፍሰ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሥጋ፡ ውስተ፡ ደሙ፡ ይእቲ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይነቅዕ፡ ደምክሙ፡ በነፍሳቲክሙ፡ እምነ፡ እደ፡ ኵሉ፡ ሰብእ፡ እምነ፡ እደ፡ ኵሉ፡ ይነቅዕ፡ አንሰ፡ ነፍሰ፡ ሰብእ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-bāḥtu śəgā məsla nafsu məsla damu ʾi-təbəlʿu ʾəsma nafsa kwəlu śəgā wəsta damu yəʾəti kama ʾi-yənaqqəʿ daməkəmu ba-nafəsātikəmu ʾəm-nə ʾəda kwəlu sabʾ ʾəm-nə ʾəda kwəlu yənaqqəʿ ʾansa nafsa sabʾ

paragraphs.text: And do thou command the children of Israel to eat no blood, so that their names and may be before the Lord our God continually. And for this law there is no limit of days, for it is for ever. They shall observe it throughout their generations, so that they may continue supplicating on your behalf with blood before the altar; every day and at the time of morning and evening they shall seek forgiveness on your behalf perpetually before the Lord that they may keep it and not be rooted out.
paragraphs.original: ወዘይክዕው፡ ደመ፡ ሰብእ፡ በሰብእ፡ ይክዐው፡ ደሙ፡ እስመ፡ በአርአያ፡ እግዚእ፡ ገብረ፡ ሰብአ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-zayəkəʿwə dama sabʾ ba-sabʾ yəkəʿaw damu ʾəsma ba-ʾarʾayā ʾəgziʾ gabra sabʾa

paragraphs.text: And He gave to Noah and his sons a sign that there should be a flood on the earth. He set His bow in the cloud for a sign of the eternal covenant should not again be a flood on the earth to destroy it all the days of the earth.
paragraphs.original: ወአንትሙስ፡ ብዝኁ፡ ወብዝኁ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾantəmusə bəzəḫu wa-bəzəḫu lāʿla mədr

paragraphs.text: reason it is ordained and written on the heavenly tablets, that they should celebrate the feast of month once a year, to renew the covenant every year. And this whole festival was celebrated in heaven from the day of creation till the days of Noah -twenty-six jubilees and five weeks of years [1309-1659 A.M.]: and Noah and his sons observed it for seven jubilees and one week of years, till the day of Noah's death, and from the day of Noah's death his sons did away with (it) until the days of Abraham, and But Abraham observed it, and Isaac and Jacob and his children observed it up to thy days, and in thy days the children of Israel forgot it until ye celebrated it anew on this mountain.
paragraphs.original: ወመሐለ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወውሉዱ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይብልዑ፡ ኵሎ፡ ደመ፡ ዘይነውዕ፡ በውስተ፡ ሥጋ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-maḥala Noḫ wa-wəludu kama ʾi-yəbəlʿu kwəlo dama zayənawwəʿ ba-wəsta śəgā

paragraphs.text: And do thou command the children of Israel to observe this festival in all their generations for a commandment unto them: one day in the year in this month they shall celebrate the For it is the feast of weeks and the feast of first fruits: this feast is twofold and of a according to what is written and engraven concerning it, celebrate it.
paragraphs.original: ወመሐለ፡ ኖኅ፡ ኪዳነ፡ በቅድሜሁ፡ በውእቱ፡ ወርኅ፡ ሣልስ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-maḥala Noḫ kidāna ba-qədmēhu ba-wəʾtu warḫ śāləs lāʿla mədr

paragraphs.text: written in the book of the first law, in that which I have written for thee, that thou shouldst celebrate it in its season, one day in the year, and I explained to thee its sacrifices that the children of Israel should remember and should celebrate it throughout their generations in this month, one day in every year.
paragraphs.original: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ይቤለከ፡ አኮ፡ ኪያከ፡ ባሕቲተከ፡ ከመ፡ አንበሮ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ምስለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ ኖኅ፡ አላ፡ እስከ፡ ኵሉ፡ ትውልድ፡ ሤመ፡ ሎቱ፡ ሥርዐተ፡ ኪዳኑ፡ ለዓለም፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu yəbēlaka ʾakko kiyāka bāḥtitaka kama ʾanbaro kidāna məsla daqiqa Noḫ ʾallā ʾəska kwəlu təwlədə śēma lottu śərʿata kidānu la-ʿālam

paragraphs.text: And on the new moon of the first month, and on the new moon of the fourth month, and on the new moon of the seventh month, and on the new moon of the tenth month are the days of remembrance, and the days of the seasons in the four divisions of the year. These are written as a testimony for ever.
paragraphs.original: ወአንተ፡ ግበር፡ በዕለታት፡ ኪዳነ፡ ላዕለ፡ ደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ ከመ፡ ኢይብልዑ፡ ኵሎ፡ ደመ፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾanta gəbar ba-ʿəlatāt kidāna lāʿla daqiqa ʾəsrāʾēl kama ʾi-yəbəlʿu kwəlo dama

paragraphs.text: And Noah ordained them for himself as feasts for the generations for ever, so that they have become thereby a memorial unto him. And on the new moon of the first month he was bidden to make for himself an ark, and on that (day) the earth became dry and (the ark) and saw the earth.
paragraphs.original: ወውእቱ፡ ዘይብላዕ፡ ደመ፡ እምነ፡ እንስሳ፡ ወእምነ፡ አራዊት፡ ወእምነ፡ አዕዋፍ፡ በኵሉ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ምድር፡ ይትሰረው፡ ብእሲሁ፡ ወብእሲቱ፡ እምነ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-wəʾtu zayəbəlāʿ dama ʾəm-nə ʾənəssā wa-ʾəm-nə ʾarāwit wa-ʾəm-nə ʾaʿwāf ba-kwəlu mawāʿəla mədr yətsaraw bəʾəsihu wa-bəʾəsitu ʾəm-nə mədr

paragraphs.text: And on the new moon of the fourth month the mouths of the depths of the abyss beneath were closed. And on the new moon of the seventh month all the the abysses of the earth were opened, and the waters began to descend into them.
paragraphs.original: ወሤመ፡ እግዚእ፡ ለኖኅ፡ ወለዘርዑ፡ ትእምርተ፡ ከመ፡ ኢይኩን፡ ካልአ፡ ማየ፡ አይኅ፡ ላዕለ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-śēma ʾəgziʾ la-Noḫ wa-la-zarʿu təʾəmərta kama ʾi-yəkun kāləʾa māya ʾāyəḫ lāʿla mədr

paragraphs.text: moon of the tenth month the tops of the mountains were seen, and Noah was glad. And on this account he ordained them for himself as feasts for a memorial for ever, and thus are And they placed them on the heavenly tablets, each had thirteen weeks; from one to another (passed) their memorial, from the first to the second, and from the second to the third, third to the fourth.
paragraphs.original: ቀስቶ፡ አንበረ፡ ላዕለ፡ ደመና፡ ለስምዕ፡ ላዕለ፡ ኪዳነ፡ ዓለም፡ ከመ፡ ኢይኩን፡ ካልአ፡ ማየ፡ አይኅ፡ ለማስኖ፡ ምድር፡
paragraphs.translit: qastō ʾanbara lāʿla damanā la-səmʿ lāʿla kidāna ʿālam kama ʾi-yəkun kāləʾa māya ʾāyəḫ la-māsno mədr

paragraphs.text: And all the days of the commandment will be two and fifty weeks of days, and (these will make) the entire year complete. Thus it is engraven and ordained on the And there is no neglecting (this commandment) for a single year or from year And command thou the children of Israel that they observe the years according to this reckoning- three hundred and sixty-four days, and (these) will constitute a complete year, and they will not disturb its time from its days and from its feasts; for everything will fall out in them their testimony, and they will not leave out any day nor disturb any feasts.
paragraphs.original: በእንተ፡ ዝንቱ፡ ተአዘዘ፡ ወተጸሐፈ፡ ላዕለ፡ ጽላተ፡ ሰማይ፡ ከመ፡ ይግበሩ፡ በዓለ፡ ሰሙናት፡ በዝንቱ፡ ወርኅ፡ አሐደ፡ ምዕር፡ በዓመት፡ ለለ፡ ዓመት፡ ለትሕድሶ፡ ኪዳን፡ በኵሉ፡ ዓመት፡ ለዓመት፡
paragraphs.translit: ba-ʾənta zəntu taʾazaza wa-taṣaḥafa lāʿla ṣəlāta samāy kama yəgbaru baʿāla samunāt ba-zəntu warḫ ʾaḥada məʿr ba-ʿāmat la-la-ʿāmat la-təḥdəso kidān ba-kwəlu ʿāmat la-ʿāmat

paragraphs.text: do neglect and do not observe them according to His commandment, then they will disturb all their seasons and the years will be dislodged from this (order), [and they will disturb the seasons will be dislodged] and they will neglect their ordinances.
paragraphs.original: ወአልቦ፡ ካልአ፡ በዓል፡ ዘይትገበር፡ ላዕለ፡ ኵሎሙ፡ ዘርእ፡ ደቂቀ፡ እስራኤል፡ እምነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ኖኅ፡ እስከ፡ መዋዕለ፡ አብርሃም፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾalbo kāləʾa baʿāl zayətgabbar lāʿla kwəlomu zarʾ daqiqa ʾəsrāʾēl ʾəm-nə mawāʿəla Noḫ ʾəska mawāʿəla ʾAbrəhām

paragraphs.text: And all the children of Israel will forget and will not find the path of the years, and will forget the new moons, and seasons, and and they will go wrong as to all the order of the years. For I know and from henceforth will I declare it unto thee, and it is not of my own devising; for the book (lies) written before me, and on the heavenly tablets the division of days is ordained, lest they forget the feasts and walk according to the feasts of the Gentiles after their error and after their For there will be those who will assuredly make observations of the moon -how (it) seasons and comes in from year to year ten days too soon.
paragraphs.original: ወወድቀ፡ ዝንቱ፡ በዓል፡ በሰማይ፡ እምነ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ፍጥረት፡ እስከ፡ መዋዕለ፡ ኖኅ፡ ፳ ወ፮ ኢዮቤልዋት፡ ወ፭ ሰሙናት፡
paragraphs.translit: wa-wadqa zəntu baʿāl ba-samāy ʾəm-nə mawāʿəla fəṭrat ʾəska mawāʿəla Noḫ 26 ʾiyobēləwāt wa-5 samunāt

paragraphs.text: For this reason the years will come upon them when they will disturb (the order), and make an abominable (day) the day of testimony, and an unclean day a feast day, and they will confound all the days, the holy with the unclean, and the unclean day with the holy; for they will go wrong as to the months and sabbaths For this reason I command and testify to thee that thou mayst testify to them; for after thy death thy children will disturb (them), so that they will not make the year three hundred and sixty-four days only, and for this reason they will go wrong as to the new moons and seasons and sabbaths and festivals, and they will eat all kinds of blood with all kinds of flesh.
paragraphs.original: ወአቀመ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወውሉዱ፡ እስከ፡ ፯ ኢዮቤልዋት፡ ወ፩ ሰሙን፡ ኢዮቤልዉ፡ እስከ፡ ሞተ፡ ኖኅ፡ ወእምነ፡ ዕለተ፡ ሞቶ፡ ለኖኅ፡ አጥፍኡ፡ ደቂቁ፡ ለነገር፡ ቅዱስ፡ እስከ፡ ዕለተ፡ አብርሃም፡ ወእምነ፡ ዘመነ፡ ኖኅ፡ እስከ፡ መዋዕለ፡ አብርሃም፡ ይብልዑ፡ ደመ፡
